editorial.headline: Putty and Surface Fillers, Open Nationally and Workable in Bali
editorial.standfirst: KBLI 20223 covers the making of putty, plamuur, non-refractory fillers, and similar surface-covering materials, with full national foreign ownership available.
editorial.body:
KBLI 20223 is a compact industrial category, but its commercial meaning is clear: it covers the manufacture of putty, plamuur, non-refractory putty, and similar materials used to close, smooth, or prepare surfaces. The record describes a production activity, not a trading desk or installation service. Its centre of gravity is the making of surface-covering materials themselves: the substances that fill gaps, even out imperfections, and prepare a substrate before finishing.

That matters for founders because the code is open across the full business-scale spectrum recorded here. Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, and Besar are all listed as scales open to this activity. In practical registration language, the record does not confine this manufacturing line to one narrow size of operator. A small producer and a larger industrial setup are both inside the scale map, provided the registered activity remains the manufacture of the listed filler and surface-covering materials.

On foreign investment, the national position is unequivocal. This record lists the PMA status as TERBUKA and sets the foreign-ownership ceiling at 100%. The stated national source is Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021. There is no basis in this slim record to add a special licence, threshold, timeline, tax treatment, capital condition, or side obligation. The honest reading is simply that, at national level, this activity is open to foreign ownership up to the recorded ceiling.

Bali does not reverse that conclusion in this record. The Bali status is marked OK_or_HIGHER_RISK, and l4_bali_blocked is false. The reason is explicit: OSS risk at scale Besar is Menengah-Tinggi/Tinggi → not blocked by moratorium. The moratorium rule in the record says Bali province blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI for PMA, island-wide and permanent, but this activity is not marked as blocked. So the editorial bottom line is clean: KBLI 20223 is nationally open, available across the listed scales, and not blocked for PMA registration in Bali on the record supplied.
editorial.pullQuote: The honest reading is that KBLI 20223 is nationally open to full foreign ownership and is not marked as blocked for PMA registration in Bali.
